SELECT B.CustomerID, A.AccountID, A.RelationshipExposure FROM DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure A 
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = 20230601 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y' AND B.CustomerID = '000000000083754'

SELECT B.CustomerID, A.AccountID, A.StatementBalance FROM DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance A 
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = 20230601 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y' AND B.CustomerID = '000000000083754'

SELECT B.CustomerID, A.AccountID, A.CurrentCreditLimit FROM DW.FactCardsCreditLimit A 
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = 20230601 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y' AND B.CustomerID = '000000000083754'

SELECT TotalRelationshipExposureFull FROM DW.TotalCustomerHoldings WHERE CustomerID = '000000000083754'

SELECT 
    RetailStatementBalanceAmount, CashStatementBalanceAmount, (RetailStatementBalanceAmount + CashStatementBalanceAmount) AS StatementBalance
    ,TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount, OutstandingInstallmentAmount, (TotalOutstandingBalanceAmount + OutstandingInstallmentAmount) AS RelationshipExposure
FROM BNKM.PaymentCardStatementSummary A 
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE CustomerId = '000000000083754'

SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit A
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE CustomerId = '000000000083754' AND LimitTypeId = 'Credit Limit'

SELECT 
    CRDACCT_CRLIMIT, CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL, CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH, (CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL + CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH) AS StatementBalance
    ,CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL, CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL, (CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL + CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL) AS RelationshipExposure
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP WHERE CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = '000000000083754'


SELECT CustomerID, FCBSCIF FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE FCBSCIF = 'R01558044' AND SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'

SELECT AccountID, AccountOpenedDate, AccountStatus, ProductName, ProductGroup FROM DW.CustomerAccountProduct WHERE CustomerID = '000000000083754' AND AccountSourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
